# Daniel Amorim de Oliveira

> Daniel Amorim is a product analytics and applied AI leader based in Lisbon, Portugal. He leads Core Product Analytics at Tripadvisor. His formal title is Product Data Analysis Manager.

His work combines international team leadership, experimentation, SQL, Python, Snowflake, and reusable AI analytics workflows. Previous employers include OLX Group, Uber, Itaú Unibanco, Banco Votorantim, and EY.

## Profile and selected work

- [Professional profile](https://danielamorim.com/): Current experience, leadership approach, education, and contact details.
- [AI analytics toolkit](https://danielamorim.com/#ai-analytics-toolkit): Reusable workflows for SQL, dashboards, experiment readouts, and metric diagnostics.
- [AI product measurement](https://danielamorim.com/#ai-product-measurement): Customer behaviour, experimentation, and AI travel planning.
- [Analytics leadership](https://danielamorim.com/#analytics-leadership): Scaling a team from 3 to 10 analysts across three countries.
- [CV](https://danielamorim.com/Resume_Daniel_Amorim.pdf): Full career history.
